server: live local game server over HTTP on the enforcing fixture node (BCH VM). No public network was contacted and no coin of any network moved: with networkProfile "mainnet" this shows that addresses, contracts, start-up conditions and attestor checks work under the Mainnet configuration, not that anything ran on Mainnet
attestors: three keys, each running scripts/prize-attest.mjs as its own process with its own key file and pin file

scenarios.name: one service purchase is a War Chest that covers the smallest stake; three payers' reward shares join one season pool
a contested territory claim is settled by the attestors: the loser's half goes to the contest winner's verified wallet
scenarios.forgedPayeeRefused: the lane does not follow the contest record

scenarios.name: matched raid, attacker wins: a forged "defender wins" proposed with the server key is refused by all three attestors
attestorProblems: the replayed battle was won by the attacker; the proposed lane "defender-wins" does not follow from it

scenarios.name: the defender starts an exit after the raid was funded: the settlement lapses and is proposed again against the exit script
matched raid settled by two of three attestors in ONE transaction: one attestor alone moves nothing; the attacker receives exactly what was previewed
matched raid, defender wins: a forged capture of the defender's War Chest and an edited battle record are both refused
forgedCaptureRefused: the replayed battle was won by the defender; the proposed lane "attacker-wins" does not follow from it
editedBattleRecordRefused: replaying the recorded battle does not reproduce its result
the replayed battle was won by the attacker; the proposed lane "defender-wins" does not follow from it

scenarios.name: the defender receives the attacker's whole stake, signed by two of three attestors; the War Chest is not an input
a paid political operation publishes its proof record from the payer's own record reserve, with no attestor and no operator money
a legitimate season prize is proposed automatically and paid after two attestors audit the season evidence
the evidence bundle an attestor saved on its own run passes the season audit from the file alone
a season result altered after the fact is refused by every attestor
attestorProblems: the amount is not rank share × prize base
season evidence: the published ranking is not the ranking the journal produces
the published season result changed after this attestor first saw it
the award does not commit to the published season result
